title: plan.md frontmatter
description: Schema for the frontmatter of plan.md, the canonical gating artifact for the develop phase. Validated by the gate engine before develop can be marked complete. Matches the AI-native SDLC playbook's 'Build' step: a plan is written and approved BEFORE implementation, not as a retrospective summary of code already written.

id.description: Ticket id this plan traces back to — must match the id on the spec.md it was drafted from

implementation_steps.description: Ordered, concrete steps — what actually gets built and in what order. Written before coding starts; the point of plan mode is reviewing the approach, not narrating what already happened.

touched_systems.description: Carried/refined from spec.md's technical_architecture — kept structured here too since develop is where a change's actual blast radius (relevant to escalation checking) becomes concrete.

test_strategy.description: What gets tested and how — always required. unit-test-writer's check-tests-before-commit.js hook enforces that tests are actually staged before any commit regardless of this field, but this is the declared intent a reviewer checks against, not a substitute for the hook.

risks_and_rollback.description: What could go wrong and how to roll back if it does. Not optional in spirit for anything touching production data or money movement — left as a default-empty string rather than required so a genuinely low-risk change doesn't have to pad this out, but an empty value on a real risk should be caught in review, not silently accepted.

open_questions.description: Anything unresolved before implementation should start. Must be empty, or explicitly waived, before develop can close.

source_docs.description: Carried forward from spec.md — the PRD/RFC this plan traces back to, if any

approved_by.description: Required when status is approved — the engineering lead (phase-graph.yaml's approval role for develop), distinct from the author when enforce_segregation_of_duties is on

approval_evidence.description: Required when status is approved (require_approval_evidence in phase-graph.yaml) — a link to where the engineering lead actually approved this plan, not just a name in approved_by.

approvals.description: One entry per approving role. Only needed when this artifact's gate asks for more than one signature (a quorum or tier strategy in .pdlc/phase-graph.yaml). A single-approver gate keeps using status/approved_by/approval_evidence. Every entry needs its own evidence link when require_approval_evidence is on — one link does not cover two people.

role.description: The approval role named by this gate in .pdlc/phase-graph.yaml, e.g. product_owner. An entry for a role the gate did not ask for does not count toward it.

by.description: The person who decided. Required when status is approved.

evidence.description: Link to where this person actually approved or declined — the Jira comment, Slack message or change record.
